requirements.acceptance: A user above their limit is blocked;
requirements.note: Outlet amount/percentage limits, cumulative refund limits, scoped named-user delegations and audit; operator limit policy review remains. A settled prepared item can only be reduced through a controlled correction workflow (`correctPreparedItem`): a manager/owner/accountant records evidence, the charged difference is returned through the controlled refund path, the consumed portion of the unsent food is reclassified as an Inventory loss (never silently restored to stock), and an idempotent correction ledger (`line_corrections`) preserves the ticket untouched.

requirements.acceptance: Unknown menu IDs enter an actionable
requirements.note: Unknown menu references never partially apply: the whole channel import is rejected atomically and a durable, actionable mapping-exception record is queued with the offending references and an attempt count. Operators maintain per-channel external-to-menu mappings (create/edit/delete) and retry the exception once mapped; a successful retry applies the original payload idempotently by channel order id and resolves the exception. Authorised provider callback adapters remain pending.

requirements.acceptance: Cash/card/refund differences are explained
requirements.note: Cash/bank tender close computes expected cash (opening, collected, deposits, refunds, paid-in/paid-out, tips) and expected bank (collected less refunds), a declared bank count and a counted cash figure, and requires an explanation for any cash or bank variance; a till closes reconciled only when both variances are zero. Recorded paid-in, paid-out and tip movements are idempotent and locked once the till closes. Full payment-terminal/gateway reconciliation and provider settlement matching remain staged gates.

requirements.acceptance: Offline order sync preserves identity and
requirements.note: Durable IndexedDB queue, registered P-256 device signing, scope/version/stock checks, idempotent replay, revocation and conflict review implemented and tested. An offline application shell (service worker + manifest) caches the interface for offline startup; kitchen/floor tickets are queued, confirmed or retained on interruption with an attempt count and a controlled reprint. Physical printer hardware validation remains an external step.

requirements.acceptance: Deposit allocation and cancellation follow
requirements.note: Capacity-aware UAE-time bookings, guarded lifecycle, walk-in waitlist, physical table groups, deposit receipts/application/original-source refunds and outstanding finance register implemented and tested. Deposit terms (no-show forfeiture cap and cancellation fee) are owner-configurable and closed-till financial corrections are recorded with evidence. Manual recorded funds only; pilot validation remains a staged gate.

requirements.acceptance: Pack-to-gram conversion and modifier usage
requirements.note: Recipe snapshots, ingredient base units and a nested versioned recipe/BOM editor (recipe-in-recipe against a prepared output ingredient) with revision history, suspend guards, recursive explosion and cycle detection are implemented. Explosion consolidates a recipe or menu item into base-ingredient quantities, cost, availability/shortfall and inherited allergens. Multi-level base-ingredient batch consumption and modifier-level substitution are implemented and tested; supplier purchase packs convert pack sizes/costs to base units.

requirements.acceptance: Rejected stock remains unavailable;
requirements.note: Accepted receipts create usable lots with expiry and hold evidence. A receipt records an inspection outcome (pass/conditional/fail); rejected quantities are logged as a non-usable 'receipt rejected' movement and never create a lot or post to stock, while accepted and rejected quantities together close the purchase balance. Multi-line purchase orders receive, reject and match per line and can enforce required receipt quality checks (for example temperature/packaging) before accepted stock is taken on.

requirements.acceptance: Approved test invoices reproduce expected
requirements.note: An owner-only tax policy (rate plus reviewed evidence) drives order/amendment VAT arithmetic and contract-period invoicing, and an accountant-reviewed tax-code register (standard/zero-rated/exempt/out-of-scope with posting account) is exposed through settings. Legal tax invoices and credit notes are issued with sequential VAT numbering and a VAT breakdown, alongside accounts ageing, gift-card ledgers, chargebacks, closed-till corrections and deposit forfeiture terms. A fiscal-period close (`closeFiscalPeriod`) finalises a date range no later than the current business date — every closed date is frozen by the posting guard, open orders/tills must be resolved first, and the close is audited and listed (`fiscalPeriods`). The default 5% is a UAE illustration and not a tax assessment; jurisdiction sign-off remains external.

requirements.acceptance: Verified-database query answers with
requirements.note: Ten role-gated assistants run deterministically on verified queries — owner briefing (today's sales/contribution/attention), demand assistant (backtested moving-average baseline into an approval-required production-plan draft with exploded ingredients), purchasing assistant (usage/on-hand/reorder/packs into approval-required order suggestions that never raise an order), menu-cost assistant (contribution review that flags risk items without changing a price), document intake (deterministic invoice extraction that never posts), reconciliation assistant (payout variances and draft bills), customer assistant (approved menu/booking answers; allergen questions escalate to a person), communication drafter (consent-aware drafts that never send), kitchen exception assistant (overdue tickets read-only) and wastage assistant (investigation proposals only — no automatic safety decision). Backing: server/ai-ext.mjs, assistant_log table, tests/ai-agent.test.mjs.

requirements.requirement: Human approval for every AI action
requirements.acceptance: Draft actions require an accepted decision
requirements.note: Every run is recorded in the assistant_log activity ledger with evidence; drafts are accepted or dismissed by owners/managers/accountants and nothing an assistant proposes is executed autonomously. Assistants never post journals, change prices, release food, decide food safety or send messages, and role gates block agents outside their allowed roles (403).

requirements.requirement: Optional LLM narration with env-only keys
requirements.acceptance: None provider without keys; keys only in env
requirements.note: A language-model layer is mounted only from AI_PROVIDER/AI_BASE_URL/AI_API_KEY/AI_MODEL environment variables (openai-compatible endpoints such as Groq/OpenRouter, or ollama; mock for hermetic evaluation). Without a key the workspace stays fully deterministic. LLM output narrates or extracts verified facts, is always labelled a draft, is never stored as a credential, and is not relied on for food-safety or clinical-diet decisions. The LLM JSON extraction path is exercised offline via setChatTransport, so no paid key is required for the automated suite.
